summary_en.motivation: To investigate the long fatigue crack growth behavior of Inconel 718 produced by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Long fatigue crack growth tests were performed on SLM-fabricated Inconel 718 specimens to measure crack growth rates.
summary_en.result: The SLM material exhibited comparable or superior fatigue crack growth resistance relative to wrought Inconel 718.
summary_en.validation: Experimental fatigue crack growth testing provided validation of the material's performance.
